text:
Response B is better. Both are accurate on the key facts (dates, the 35-degree threshold, the 15% battery figure, the New Zealand time zone fix), but Response A adds an unsupported claim. Its closing line, "No action is required from the team," is not in the release notes and is a judgement the manager may not be able to rely on. Response A also runs past the 120-word limit, at roughly 155 words. Response B stays under the limit at about 119 words and keeps the points a manager needs. Its only omissions are the Settings location for turning off heat warnings and the community-tester thanks, neither of which is essential. Response B is also clearer, grouping items under headings the manager can scan quickly.

Verdict: B
